copy.tagline_en: Collect user feedback signals to improve system behavior
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to optimize AI output based on user actions

howto.what: 安装反馈循环技能后，Claude会根据你的点赞、点踩、直接编辑输出或提供纠正等反馈，在对话中即时调整回答，并记住你的偏好。
howto.when: 当你对Claude的输出做出评价（如点赞/点踩）、修改其回复内容、提供正确答案，或要求它重试并给出指导时。

say.text: 这个回答不对，应该是2023年而不是2024年。
say.note: Claude会记住这个纠正，类似情况用正确年份。

say.text: 我还是更喜欢刚才的第二个选项。
重新回答，要更正式一点。
say.note: Claude会根据你的指导重新生成。

howto.what_en: With Feedback Loops enabled, Claude adapts based on your thumbs up/down, inline edits, corrections, or preference choices, adjusting responses in real time and remembering preferences across sessions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you rate (thumbs up/down), edit Claude's output, provide a correction, or ask for a redo with specific guidance.

say_en.text: That answer is wrong, it should be 2023, not 2024.
say_en.note: Claude will remember the correction for similar contexts.

say_en.text: I prefer the second option you gave earlier.
say_en.note: Claude will prioritize your stated preference.

say_en.text: Try again, but make it more formal.
